firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose a starting player. With the Variable Setup (side 2 of the Player Boards), the player with the most Virtue starts instead.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from the starting player.
In the standard setup the starting player receives 3 Silver, the 2nd player 4 Silver, and so on; in Variable Setup players do not gain extra Silver for turn order.
In solo play you always take your turn first, followed by the Byzantine opponent.
